title: MORAD: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Objective Rewards for RNA Inverse Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.13305v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce MORAD, an online reinforcement learning framework for backbone-conditioned RNA diffusion models that trains a single shared policy across diverse target backbones. Structure-conditioned RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences compatible with a target three-dimensional backbone, yet existing reinforcement learning approaches either optimize a separate policy for each target backbone or rely on offline preference optimization, leaving online post-training of a reusable backbone-conditioned model largely unexplored. MORAD combines backbone-conditioned group sampling, group-relative reward normalization, and a forward-process diffusion objective. Beyond existing RL rewards that primarily target tertiary structural quality, MORAD jointly optimizes six measurements spanning tertiary geometry, base pairing, ensemble behavior, and sequence composition. translated_title: MORAD：基于多目标奖励的RNA逆向设计强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了MORAD，这是一个面向骨架条件RNA扩散模型的在线强化学习框架，能够在多种目标骨架上训练单一的共享策略。结构条件的RNA逆向设计旨在寻找与目标三维骨架相兼容的核苷酸序列，然而现有的强化学习方法要么为每个目标骨架单独优化一个策略，要么依赖离线偏好优化，使得可复用的骨架条件模型的在线后训练在很大程度上尚未被探索。MORAD结合了骨架条件组采样、组相对奖励归一化以及前向过程扩散目标。超越现有主要针对三级结构质量的强化学习奖励，MORAD联合优化了涵盖三级几何、碱基配对、集合行为和序列组成的六项测量指标。为了在尺度差异下聚合这些异构目标……
tldr: MORAD提出了一个在线强化学习框架，通过联合优化涵盖三级几何、碱基配对、集合行为和序列组成的六项多目标奖励，为骨架条件RNA扩散模型训练单一可复用的共享策略，用于RNA逆向设计。
en_tdlr: MORAD is an online reinforcement learning framework that trains a single reusable shared policy for backbone-conditioned RNA inverse design by jointly optimizing six multi-objective rewards spanning tertiary geometry, base pairing, ensemble behavior, and sequence composition.
